trace.final:
## Summary

**Issue:** checkout-api was failing health checks after deploy **v2.3.1** — unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an **18% error rate**.

**Actions taken:**
1. Reviewed deployment history — identified **v2.3.0** as the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.2.9 and v2.3.0 were both healthy; v2.3.1 was not).
2. Rolled back all production regions to **v2.3.0**. No change-manager approval was needed since v2.3.0 had been healthy in production before.
3. Verified recovery: all three regions now running v2.3.0, service is **healthy**, error rate down to **0.2%**.
4. Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** documenting the failure and the rollback — the on-call engineer has been paged.
